items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Sidney didn't remember me going to the same school as he, but I did remember my cousin Theophilus Chenault and I became better acquainted with Sidney De Paris after I told him that Theophilus was my cousin.

ctx.x: One day I was playing in Sinton Park and I heard someone call another boy Gabriel and I was curious to know who this was because I have been told that I was a very fine trumpet player. He was playing baseball with some other boys and when I did get a good look at him, I saw that it was Sidney De Paris whom I had attended school with in Crawfordsville, Indiana and played the alto horn at church concerts.

The medicine shows were always on at an early hour of the evening and Sidney started playing with Clarence Page at the open air pavillion where Dolly Jones had played. I heard Gabriel blow many times that summer.

Wilbur De Paris played with some orchestra in the Sterling Hotel, so I never heard him. Sidney didn't remember me going to the same school as he, but I did remember my cousin Theophilus Chenault and I became better acquainted with Sidney De Paris after I told him that Theophilus was my cousin.
